title: DiscoVista-Next: phylogenetic discordance visualization and analysis in Python 3
description:
DiscoVista-Next is a Python 3 rewrite of DiscoVista (Discordance Visualization Tool) that removes the R dependency of the original tool while keeping its input formats and command-line conventions.

Features:

  • Six analysis modes: species tree discordance, gene tree discordance, GC content, occupancy, branch support versus branch length, and relative frequency
  • qt-material based graphical interface with 26 color themes and Chinese/English switching
  • Command-line interface compatible with the original DiscoVista argument format
  • matplotlib + seaborn visualization replacing ggplot2
  • PyInstaller packaging support for standalone executables
  • Bilingual documentation (Chinese/English)

Source code: https://github.com/ZengZichao/DiscoVista-Next
